title: Python for engineers
why: Every applied AI role is Python first. This module moves you from scripts that run once to code that other people can read, import and trust.
outcomes: Write typed functions and modules without notes
Handle files, JSON, CSV and errors cleanly
Call web APIs with httpx and understand async basics
lessons: Core types, functions and control flow: first 15 Exercism Python exercises without notes
Files, JSON, CSV and pathlib: write a script that cleans a messy CSV
Errors and exceptions: raise, catch and write useful error messages
Comprehensions, generators and iterators: process a large file lazily
Classes and dataclasses: model a document with metadata
Call a web API with httpx, then make three calls concurrently with asyncio
resources: Only if placement said Start here
method: Type every example; never paste. Solve each Exercism problem before reading community solutions, then compare. Reading better code than yours is the fastest way to improve.
build: A command-line tool that reads a folder of text files and outputs word counts and the longest document as JSON. Typed, with error handling.
